teaser.en: Red flower balls dangle on long strings below its flat crown, and in hard times its seeds kept people alive.
teaser.sw: Mipira ya maua mekundu huning'inia kwenye kamba ndefu chini ya kilele chake bapa, na nyakati za shida mbegu zake ziliokoa maisha ya watu.

summary.en: *Mnyendze*, the African locust bean, is a tall flat-crowned tree of moist coastal forest with feathery leaves and red ball-shaped flower heads hanging on long stalks. Its young pods are eaten, its seeds are a famine food, and its wood makes beehives, stools and timber.
summary.sw: *Mnyendze*, au *mnienze*, ni mti mrefu wenye kilele bapa wa misitu yenye unyevu ya pwani, wenye majani kama manyoya na vishada vya maua mekundu vyenye umbo la mpira vinavyoning'inia kwenye mashina marefu. Maganda yake machanga huliwa, mbegu zake ni chakula cha njaa, na mbao zake hutengeneza mizinga ya nyuki, vigoda na mbao za ujenzi.

about.en:
*Mnyendze* is a deciduous tree that can grow from 8 to 30 metres, with a wide, flat crown. The leaves are feathery and twice divided.

Its flowers are unforgettable: dense, red, ball-shaped heads that dangle on long stalks beneath the crown, like decorations on strings. In many *Parkia* species these hanging flower balls are visited at night by bats. They give way to long pods.
about.sw:
*Mnyendze* ni mti unaopukutisha majani unaoweza kufikia urefu wa mita 8 hadi 30, wenye kilele kipana na bapa. Majani yake ni kama manyoya na yamegawanyika mara mbili.

Maua yake hayasahauliki: vishada vizito, vyekundu, vyenye umbo la mpira vinavyoning'inia kwenye mashina marefu chini ya kilele, kama mapambo yaliyofungwa kwenye kamba. Kwa spishi nyingi za *Parkia*, mipira hii ya maua inayoning'inia hutembelewa na popo usiku. Baadaye huzaa maganda marefu.

where.en: It grows in moist lowland and riverine forest along the coast. The hanging red flower balls make it easy to recognise when it is in bloom.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu yenye unyevu ya nyanda za chini na misitu ya kando ya mito pwani. Mipira ya maua mekundu inayoning'inia huufanya uwe rahisi kutambulika unapochanua.

uses.en:
The young pods are eaten. The mature seeds are eaten only in an emergency, as a famine food.

The wood is used to make beehives, stools and water containers, and Pakia lists *mnyendze* among the popular timber trees. The bark yields tannin and dye.
uses.sw:
Maganda machanga huliwa. Mbegu zilizokomaa huliwa tu wakati wa dharura, kama chakula cha njaa.

Mbao hutumika kutengeneza mizinga ya nyuki, vigoda na vyombo vya maji, na Pakia inaorodhesha *mnyendze* miongoni mwa miti maarufu ya mbao. Gome lake hutoa tanini na rangi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mnyendze*; the ICRAF handbook writes *myenze*. In Swahili it is *mnienze* or *mkunde*. In English it is called the African locust bean.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mnyendze*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinaandika *myenze*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mnienze* au *mkunde*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African locust bean*.

reason.en: Another feathery-leaved tree of the bean family
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa jamii ya kunde wenye majani kama manyoya

reason.sw: Mti wa kando ya mito wenye matunda yanayoliwa na mbao za vigoda

reason.sw: Mti wa maganda wenye nyama inayoliwa na gome litoalo rangi
